title: Host behavior during a scan phase
statement: Let $m>0$, let $\delta:A\times\mathrm{Option}(\Gamma)\to A$, choose $a_0\in A$ and an acceptance predicate $\mathrm{acc}:A\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and let $j$ be an index with $0\le j<m$. Let $a\in A$, let $w$ be a word over $\Gamma$, and suppose a two-work-tape configuration $d$ has forward scan state $a$ and tape 0 contains the encoding of $w$ at all offsets from $-1$ through $|w|$. Let $q$ be a combined phase and control state such that the host's redirect from scan phase $j$ with completed accumulator equal to the result of folding $\delta$ over $w$ from $a$ leads to $q$. For every $u\le 2|w|+2$, the host machine started with $d$ in phase $j$ agrees with the standalone scan machine for $u$ steps, with its control state tagged by phase $j$. One further step takes the host configuration to $d$ with its state replaced by $q$.
